name: overwrite-guard
description: Stops Claude from rewriting whole existing files: Write on an existing file and shell commands that replace one (>, tee, cp, mv, python/node writes) are refused with a request to use Edit.

protectedExtensions.title: Protected extensions
protectedExtensions.description: File extensions whose files a shell command may not replace as a whole, separated by commas, without dots. * protects every file. Write is refused on every existing file, whatever its extension.
protectedExtensions.default: md, ts, tsx, js, jsx, mjs, cjs, php, json, yaml, yml, sh, bash, html, css, scss, py, sql, env, conf, caddy, toml

freeFolders.title: Free folders
freeFolders.description: Folders in which files may be rewritten freely, separated by commas. An absolute path or ~/… frees everything below it; a bare name (scratchpad, node_modules) frees every folder of that name; a relative path is read from the project folder.

allowedFiles.title: Allowed files
allowedFiles.description: Files that may be rewritten as a whole, as patterns separated by commas, e.g. package-lock.json, docs/generated/**, **/*.snap. * matches within one folder name, ** across folders; a pattern without / matches the file name anywhere; others are read from the project folder or are absolute.
